ops.title: cc-pane data-layer wire facts: viz 500 = notes-unavailable; fleet join key is repos[].cwd
ops.body:
Two load-bearing facts verified by live probes (2026-07-17, B0 phase):

1. **`cc-notes viz` never fails to start in a repo without cc-notes.** In a repo with zero `refs/cc-notes/*` the server binds a port, prints the URL on stdout (exact format: `http://127.0.0.1:<port>\n`, nothing else on stdout; stderr carries a human-readable line), and exits 0 on SIGTERM. Unavailability surfaces **per-request**: `GET /api/graph` → HTTP 500 with body `{"error":"cannot determine trunk: no ref for main"}`. cc-pane's "notes unavailable" detection must treat a graph 500 as the signal, not connection-refused or spawn failure (spawn failure is a second, distinct unavailable path).

2. **`cco.fleet.status` repos rows have `cwd`, not `path`.** Full key set per row kind (from live capture in tests/fixtures/fleet-status.json): repos `{backend, created_at, cwd, id, name, status}`; workstreams `{backend, branch, ccnotes_project, created_at, id, is_primary, name, repo_id, status, workspace_handle, worktree}`; agents `{activity, backend, ccnotes_task, created_at, id, last_restart_at, name, prompt, restart_count, scope, session_id, sprint_id, state, status, subject_id, terminal_handle, tokens, updated_at}`. The registry⋈repos join is `registry[].path === repos[].cwd` (A1's Go side joins on symlink-canonical Cwd). The `registry[]` contract entry shape: `{relpath, path, origin?, trunk?, local_only?, repo_id?}`.
